subject: Hiring: Staff Serving Eng — slate, scenarios & slot routing
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staff Serving Eng — alignment on slate, scenario ownership, and slot routing

Team — quick alignment request ahead of Alex Gupta's on-site next week (Staff Serving Eng, IC staff). I want us to be explicit about: role scope signals to look for, which interviewer covers which lens, and a clear plan for slot routing so the candidate flow feels cohesive.

Quick context: Alex is strong on distributed inference infra (previous at small infra startup) — we want to validate system design depth + long-term impact + mentorship potential. The slate I'm proposing (60m + 30m debrief) is:
- System & architecture deep dive (60m) — probes on latency/cost tradeoffs, model KV cache strategies, multi-tenant routing.
- Execution / ownership + post-mortem behavior (30m) — focused behavioral examples.
- Optional 1:1 with bar-raiser for cross-cutting impact (15–30m) if we need more signal.

Attachments: scoring-rubric-v3.pdf (anchor changes), scenario-pack-kv-caching.odt, interviewer-cheatsheet.md.

Asks:
- Markus: can you take the deep-design slot and own the KV-caching scenario? I want your bar-raiser lens on long-term tradeoffs and mentorship questions.
- Marissa: can you own the execution/ownership slice and the rubric calibration?
- Laura: can you act as primary debrief facilitator and ensure we reserve 30m immediately after the interview for scoring?

Also, we need to route candidate availability. Sarah (external recruiter) is coordinating — I'm going to loop her in after we confirm owners. If we need to tweak timing (90m vs 60m + follow up) say so.

Short responses please — ideally today so I can lock invites.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scoring-rubric-v3.pdf (3 pages), scenario-pack-kv-caching.odt (5 scenarios), interviewer-cheatsheet.md
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staff Serving Eng — alignment on slate, scenario ownership, and slot routing

+1 on taking the deep-design slot. I'll run scenario #2 (KV cache eviction and multi-model serving tradeoffs) and will prepare two anchor questions that map to the rubric's "long-term impact" and "system tradeoffs" rows.

A couple of suggested tweaks from the bar-raiser perspective:
- Make sure the rubric has explicit anchors for "clarity of tradeoffs" (not just correctness). I've added a short note in the rubric PDF — see attached version (I highlighted line items).
- Reserve an extra 15 minutes in the debrief for disagreement resolution; often we need the time to reconcile signal.

I prefer the 60m deep dive with an immediate 30m debrief. If the candidate pushes back for shorter, we can do 45m + 30m debrief but it reduces system-depth signal.

I'll bring a follow-up example prompt to test incremental reasoning about kernel selection under memory pressure.

— Markus
Bar-raiser, Serving Runtime

(Attachment: scoring-rubric-v3.pdf [annotated])
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staff Serving Eng — alignment on slate, scenario ownership, and slot routing

Thanks Priyom — happy to own execution/ownership and calibration. I'll update the interviewer-cheatsheet.md with two behavioral anchors (decision-making under ambiguity, ownership of cross-team tech debt) and share before EOD.

Laura — can you confirm you'll block the 30m debrief directly after Markus's deep-design slot? If we can keep a hard end + debrief buffer in the same meeting room (or VC), it helps ensure debrief happens.

One note: does anyone need the candidate's resume or a short brief for the kernel-level prompts? If so, I'll ask Sarah to forward.

Marissa
Sr. PM, Recruiting Partnerships

From: Sarah Patel <sarah@talentbridge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Alex Gupta — availability + resume

Hi all — looping in with candidate availability and the resume (attached). Alex can do Wed 15th or Thu 16th (PST) morning; prefers a single 90m block but is flexible for 60m deep + 30m debrief.

Calendar link to proposed slot: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
Resume (PDF): candidate-resume-alex-gupta.pdf (attached)

Please let me know which day/time you prefer and I'll lock it.

Thanks,
Sarah Patel
Senior Technical Recruiter — TalentBridge
sarah@talentbridge.com
(Attachment: candidate-resume-alex-gupta.pdf)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@talentbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alex Gupta — availability + resume

Thanks Sarah — let's lock Thu 16th, 09:30–11:00 PST (90m consolidated). Markus will lead the deep design + KV scenario; Marissa will run the behavioral slice; Laura will facilitate debrief immediately after the session in the same VC room for 30m.

Action items I will own:
- Upload the annotated rubric and scenario pack to the drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1scenariopack
- Confirm interviewer cheatsheet updates with Marissa by EOD Wed.
- Ensure interview room is reserved and add 30m debrief immediately after the 90m block.

Marissa/Markus/Laura — please reply-only-if-you-see-a-problem. If no reply I will send invites and confirm with Sarah.

— Priyom
